data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Roger total 36, reducing to 9. Number 9 is associated with compassion, idealism and completion.

in_greek.name: Ελληνικά_Roger

in_latin.name: Roger
in_latin.long_meaning: Nomen Roger est nomen Christianum quod significat Famous spear. Hoc nomen in cultura Christiana est valde significativum.
